maddeler.e:
أتساهل (form VI)
# أَتَسَاهَلُ (ʔatasāhalu) /ʔa.ta.saː.ha.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
# أَتَسَاهَلَ (ʔatasāhala) /ʔa.ta.saː.ha.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
# أَتَسَاهَلْ (ʔatasāhal) /ʔa.ta.saː.hal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
